candidate_axiom.name: Spinozan Substance Monism & Attribute Parallelism
candidate_axiom.statement: System state is fundamentally unified under one immutable substrate; operational views (control flow, data flow, telemetry) are pure orthogonal attribute projections over that single substance.
candidate_axiom.operational_rule: Independent disparate state storage systems that lack canonical single-source synchronization are rejected.

system_profile.archetype: Unified Substance Monad with Orthogonal Projections
system_profile.topology_type: Monistic Central Kernel with Stratified Attribute Projections
system_profile.topology_diagram:
┌──> [Projection 1: Execution Flow]
              │
[Single Substance Monad] ──┼──> [Projection 2: Memory Graph]
              │
              └──> [Projection 3: Telemetry Stream]

Substance Monad Kernel.role: Maintains the singular, authoritative ontological state of the architecture.
Substance Monad Kernel.invariant_rule: All mutations must resolve within the primary monad.

Attribute Projection Fabric.role: Computes pure functional views for execution, debugging, and persistence.
Attribute Projection Fabric.invariant_rule: Projections are read-only and cannot mutate underlying substance.

Parallelism Synchronizer.role: Guarantees instantaneous consistency across all operational attribute views.
Parallelism Synchronizer.invariant_rule: State skew between projections is strictly forbidden.

target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Eliminates cache coherence bugs and split-brain states (+0.0160).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Produces clean, highly unified system architectures (+0.0150).

tradeoffs.strengths: Completely eliminates synchronization discrepancies and split-brain scenarios.
tradeoffs.constraints: High performance requirements on the central substance monad.

leaderboard.name: Landauer's Thermodynamic Principle of Reversible Computation
leaderboard.statement: Architectural transformations that discard intermediate computational states must formally account for entropy dissipation, favoring logically reversible morphisms that preserve state reconstructibility.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Irreversible lossy projections without explicit audit trails or invertibility witnesses are penalized.
leaderboard.domain: Physical Information Theory (Rolf Landauer & Charles Bennett)
leaderboard.principle: Information Erasure Dissipation and Reversible Computing

system_profile.topology_type: Reversible Morphism Pipeline with Conservation Rails
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Ingress State S] ──> [Reversible Transformation] ──> [Egress State S']
                                  │                               │
                                  └───> [Information Conservation] ◄──┘
                                                │
                                                ▼
                                    [Audit Lineage Ledger]

Reversible Morphism Engine.role: Executes state transformations using bijective mappings.
Reversible Morphism Engine.invariant_rule: Every forward step must have a computable backward inverse.

Information Conservation Auditor.role: Tracks bit-erasure entropy across pipeline stages.
Information Conservation Auditor.invariant_rule: Penalizes destructive state mutations that destroy history.

Audit Lineage Ledger.role: Maintains lightweight reconstructibility markers for state rollbacks.
Audit Lineage Ledger.invariant_rule: Guarantees exact past state reconstructibility without full dumps.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Brings thermodynamic physics into software architecture (+0.0130).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Enables instant time-travel debugging and zero-cost rollbacks (+0.0150).

tradeoffs.strengths: Complete lineage traceability; enables deterministic rollback and replay.
tradeoffs.constraints: Requires tracking inverse operations or maintaining reversible logs.

leaderboard.name: Peircean Semiotic Triad & Pragmatic Maxim
leaderboard.statement: Module interfaces must decouple representational tokens from physical execution objects through an explicit mediation interpretant, preventing direct token-state semantic coupling.
leaderboard.formal_expression: \text{Sign}(R, O, I): \; R \xrightarrow{I} O \quad \text{where} \quad R \cap O = \emptyset
leaderboard.operational_rule: Direct coupling of internal memory structures to wire formats without an explicit interpretive schema is rejected.

Representamen Encoder.role: Serializes module intent into syntactic representational tokens.
Representamen Encoder.invariant_rule: Tokens must be purely symbolic and free of runtime pointers.

Contextual Interpretant.role: Interprets tokens within dynamic context to determine pragmatic meaning.
Contextual Interpretant.invariant_rule: Mediates all interactions between symbols and memory states.

Object State Grounder.role: Applies interpreted actions to underlying physical system state.
Object State Grounder.invariant_rule: Rejects malformed interpretations before state mutation.

target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Quickly detects protocol drift and semantic mismatches (+0.0140).

tradeoffs.strengths: Total decoupling of serialization format from internal data structures.
tradeoffs.constraints: Adds interpretant mediation step to inter-module communications.
